combinedRuntimeFootprint.interpretation: Raw geometry = all allocated 7×Float32 terrain vertices + drawn Uint32 triangle indices. It is the data-buffer payload for one copy, not total process/GPU memory. Includes both old 2m and 5m geometry simultaneously; increment has only 2m. Excludes CEDD clip/seam, R06 coast and tunnel geometry modifications, routes, station, buildings, train, materials, GPU/driver overhead, retained JS arrays, and temporary copies. Geometry sizes are a reproducible baseline estimate, not an observed R06 final memory measurement.
combinedRuntimeFootprint.HTTPNote: No live HTTP content-encoding transfer measurement made. Base64/HTML bytes are decoded response-body storage size and must not be labelled wire-transfer bytes.
combinedRuntimeFootprint.scope: Eager inner 30m background + 5 old detail patches × 2 LODs + 4 Kowloon CEDD increment patches only; exterior spectrum and full-region ocean texture reported separately below.

caveats: Old detail source contribution is less than native crop area: protected story edits and water masks are retained; outer 100m is a synthetic transition.
Old native crop valid area, weighted runtime contribution area and rectangle envelope are different quantities and must not be interchanged.
Both LODs represent the same spatial patches; do not add their areas or node counts as unique spatial coverage.
Four incremental patches have all native source support and weight255, but only limited Kowloon domain; native acquisition 2019-2020 is not historic pre-1997 terrain.
Increment external height mismatch up to 28.644248867m is closed with explicitly synthetic vertical display geometry, not height blending or survey continuity.
Lion Rock source is terrain surface, not tunnel rail elevation.
0.5m native sample spacing is not a claim of vertical accuracy.

startupBottlenecks.finding: 32 gzip payloads serially awaited before terrain mesh construction
startupBottlenecks.detail: Background heights then mask, followed by five patches × two LODs × heights/mask/weight. atob and Uint8Array.from perform synchronous base64 conversion; DecompressionStream may schedule internal work but top-level await serializes these requests.

startupBottlenecks.finding: Every old detail LOD is eagerly generated on the main thread
startupBottlenecks.detail: Nested loops calculate positions/normals and allocate per-node arrays; push triangle indices into JS number arrays; hkMesh copies to Uint32Array for upload. LOD selection changes only draw choice; both LOD geometries are already decoded, generated and uploaded.

startupBottlenecks.finding: Increment coefficients are fetched in parallel, then synchronously expanded
startupBottlenecks.detail: Promise.all covers four patch downloads/decompressions, but each createPatch loops every 2m node across all four bilinear basis levels on the main JS thread. Float64 raw decode is copied into another Float64Array; Float32 heights and two Uint8 masks are then built. No worker handoff is used.

startupBottlenecks.finding: R06 front-loads dependencies and whole legacy HTML before host execution
startupBottlenecks.detail: Sequential awaits for station registration, terrain increment, rail vertical profile, airport data, patch config and host response precede document.write. Terrain payload is inline in a ~14.69MB HTML string, copied through text patching and reparsed.

startupBottlenecks.finding: R06 postprocessing adds repeated large geometry scans and copies
startupBottlenecks.detail: Original background geometry is clipped for CEDD rectangles, combined with seam closure, extended for coast, then copied/clipped for the tunnel. Each detail LOD also passes tunnel clipTerrain, which scans indices and allocates fresh output arrays even when almost all triangles remain untouched. Raw buffer totals understate peak transient heap.

startupBottlenecks.finding: Full exterior ocean mask decoded/uploaded eagerly; exterior terrain chunks otherwise camera-driven
startupBottlenecks.detail: Whole 4,968,652-byte R8 mask is eagerly loaded. 320 exterior coefficient/mask chunk pairs are stored, but selected exterior mesh loads happen on draw, limited by 96MiB GPU budget and 2 concurrent mesh loads.

startupBottlenecks.finding: Exterior source caches accumulate independently of GPU eviction
startupBottlenecks.detail: Camera changes free GPU resources, not coefficient/mask source caches. Source neighbours also load for normals. Each mesh uses synchronous spectrum evaluation per vertex and four neighbour normals; local full pre-compaction arrays and Float64 heights add transient CPU allocations.

scopeAndLimitations: No original app files edited. Only this audit JSON and reproducible research script are written.
No live performance timings or browser heap/GPU capture were obtained.
Full TIFF-decoded byte counts refer to base image samples only, not TIFF metadata, overviews or additional buffers.
Existing terrain spectrum is local hierarchical bilinear-hat residual representation with Float64 coefficients, not automatically a universal/frozen KAOPU schema.

outer30mSpectrum.basis: H(E,N)=sum of shared tensor-product piecewise-linear hat basis fields at node steps 240,120,60,30m; each finer coefficient field is the residual needed against the previous reconstructed field. Query directly at arbitrary E,N, or regenerate sampled mesh on demand.
outer30mSpectrum.sourceType: Edited digital surface model (DSM), includes vegetation/buildings, not bare-earth DTM
ownership: existing high-resolution local 2m/5m patches and frozen authored station terrain
existing frozen background/story edits inside original domain
this outer spectrum outside those owned domains

runtimeLoading.visibility: Camera-visible eligible exterior chunks, sorted by distance to mapState.target; excludes all-ocean and entirely old-owned chunks.
runtimeLoading.neighbourSourceLoads: Each desired mesh loads up to 3×3 (9) source chunks for boundary/normal evaluation; chunk coefficient+water downloads are parallel and deduplicated by evaluator pending cache.
runtimeLoading.GPUAccounting: Compacted 6×Float32 positions/normals + Uint32 indices + full-resolution R8UI per-chunk categorical water mask.
runtimeLoading.gpuEviction: Undesired chunks are deleted from GPU buffers and textures when desired camera set changes.
runtimeLoading.cpuSourceEviction: Renderer sourceChunks and evaluator loaded caches retain decoded coefficient/mask chunks; renderer never calls unloadChunk on camera eviction. CPU source bytes may accumulate toward full inventory (32,022,752 B).
runtimeLoading.measurementNote: Static local audit; no live camera/session snapshot. Full 320-chunk inventory is not startup/current-view resident load.

outer30mSpectrum.geometryCalculation: Exact index eligibility and vertex-compaction counts from existing buildOuterMesh logic and decoded chunk waterClass; heights/normals change values, not these buffer byte counts. This all-eligible total is inventory, not concurrent GPU residency.

sourceQA.waterMaskIdentity: each output chunk roundtrips the exact projected official WBM bytes; no land threshold, smoothing, erosion, connected-component deletion or mask LOD
sourceQA.coastlineAndIsletLimit: 1 arc-second source and nearest 30m reprojection cannot guarantee sub-cell rocks or shorelines. Retained tiny source components must not be discarded by renderer triangle masks.
sourceQA.gzipTransportOnly: gzip wraps shared-basis coefficients and necessary residuals, not a claim of procedural terrain synthesis

outerOceanMask.sourceOverlap: Same categorical full-region water classes also occur in chunk waterClass files; this is a separate upload/storage cache, not new geographic coverage.
outerOceanMask.ownership: Inside old map use the old map mask unchanged; this cache is only consulted outside.
outerOceanMask.noNewOceanGeometry: Extends existing ocean shader domain and adds mask texture; does not replace the sea material/wave mother.

allTerrainLedger.meaning: Explicitly separates full stored asset inventory from startup and camera-dependent resident allocations; no HTTP transfer or live-heap claim.

all30mAssets.caution: Overlapping spatial ownership and repeated mask storage are deliberately separate assets. This number is inventory across all files, not unique cells or startup memory.
